answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A ridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dawn of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
